Title: Successful User Registration with Valid Data
Steps: 1. Navigate to /register 2. Fill Name, Email, Password 3. Agree to Terms 4. Click Submit
Expected Result: Registration successful banner shown, confirmation email sent

Title: Registration Form Validation with Invalid Email
Steps: 1. Enter invalid email format 2. Submit form
Expected Result: Inline validation error 'Please enter a valid email address'

Title: Account Lockout after 5 Failed Attempts
Steps: 1. Enter incorrect password 5 times consecutively 2. Attempt 6th login with correct password
Expected Result: Account locked for 15 minutes; warning message displayed

Title: Search with Valid Keyword
Steps: 1. Type 'Wireless Headphones' in search bar 2. Press Enter

Title: Search Field XSS / SQL Injection Check
Expected Result: Script sanitized safely; message 'No products found'

Title: Filter by Price Slider and Category
Expected Result: Only items in Audio between $50 and $200 shown
Actual Result: Items priced $200.50 and $205 returned due to rounding bug

Title: Add Item to Cart and Verify Badge Count
Steps: 1. Select quantity 2 2. Click Add to Cart
Expected Result: Cart icon updates to 2, cart drawer opens with $240 total

Title: Exceeding Warehouse Available Stock
Steps: 1. Try typing quantity 5 2. Click Add to Cart
Expected Result: System restricts quantity to 3 with warning toast

Title: Applying Expired Coupon Code
Steps: 1. Apply promo code SUMMER2023 2. Click Apply

Title: Cart Persistence After Browser Refresh
Pre-Conditions: Guest user has 2 items in cart
Steps: 1. Refresh browser tab 2. Check cart drawer

Title: Place Order with Valid Sandbox Card
Steps: 1. Proceed to checkout 2. Enter address 3. Enter test card 4242 4. Click Pay

Title: Double-Clicking 'Place Order' Button Prevention
Expected Result: Button disables immediately, only 1 order created
Actual Result: Button not disabled; creates 2 duplicate orders and charges
